identity.title: Retain Edge Based Matching and Auto MPoint XAML Partials after concrete owner audit

origin.summary: The user requested that Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that each remaining Partial be structurally reviewed rather than mechanically deleted or split.

state.current_summary: EdgeBasedMatchingToolWpfView.xaml.cs와 AutoMPointTeachingPanel.xaml.cs를 no-change 구조 감사로 확인했다. View는 XAML/composition adapter, Panel은 presentation/localization View Partial로 남고, AutoMPointTeachingController는 teaching mutable state/event/dialog/algorithm workflow, AutoMPointHtmlReportExporter는 report file-I/O, 기존 matching controller/base/factory는 property/preview/creation/lifetime을 소유한다. 새 독립 seam이 없어 production split은 만들지 않았으며, Debug/Release contract/build와 Edge Based Matching WPF smoke가 통과했다.

objective.summary: Audit the Edge Based Matching and Auto MPoint XAML Partials and retain them only when existing concrete owners already provide the necessary state, workflow, report, binding, and lifetime boundaries without a new split.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not add a service, interface, manager, wrapper, forwarding Partial, or ViewModel split for file length alone.
Preserve EdgeBasedMatchingToolWpfView and AutoMPointTeachingPanel XAML names, automation IDs, property/preview facade, Auto MPoint teaching workflow, report export path, and DisposeView lifetime.
Keep test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or mutate the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records current/intended owners, caller path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public/test contract, shortest reading order, and the reason no production split is justified.

The source contract proves that the Edge Based Matching View and Auto MPoint Panel Partials have no misplaced direct algorithm/file coupling and that the existing controller, exporter, factory, composition, and base lifetime owners are wired.

Focused Debug/Release contracts and builds, relevant Edge Based Matching WPF smoke, readiness, structural audit, documentation index, issue validation, and diff checks pass; broader UI/native/hardware matrices remain explicitly unverified.

No independent state/lifetime/test seam justifies a new Partial or wrapper.

events.summary: Edge Based Matching/Auto MPoint XAML Partials are required composition/presentation boundaries. Existing matching controller, teaching controller, report exporter, factory/composition, and base lifetime owners already form the necessary seams; a mechanical split would add a wrapper or duplicate state, so the family is retained without production changes.
PL-0037 is resolved only after the repository readiness, structural, documentation, issue, and diff checks pass. Broader theme/DPI/input/native/hardware runtime remains outside this slice.

The Edge Based Matching/Auto MPoint Partial audit found no independent boundary that justified a production split; focused source/build/WPF evidence was recorded. Do not reopen without a new requirement, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency/lifetime boundary.
